mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monitor_data (land_id, temperature, humidity, soil_moisture, light_intensity) VALUES (#{landId}, #{temperature}, #{humidity}, #{soilMoisture}, #{lightIntensity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, land_id, temperature, humidity, soil_moisture, light_intensity, create_time FROM monitor_data WHERE land_id = #{landId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
